correctness.rationale: PASS: Established and independently integrated Hermite cross-STFT identities yield \(P_{n,t}(z)=z^n/\sqrt{n!}+tL_n(|z|^2)\) with nonzero gauge. Its imaginary part forces \(2n\) rays and \(P(0)=t\). Laguerre simple positive roots and Rolle give \(n-1\) distinct positive zeros of \(H_n^*(s)=2sL_n^{\prime}(s)-nL_n(s)\); an additional negative real root and degree \(n\) exclude all others and imply simple critical points. Strict monotonicity on outer intervals, one strict extremum in every gap, and the radial target-level equation prove the exact formula for all \(t>0\), including coincident thresholds. Explicit Jacobian and nonzero radial curvature/angular derivative establish regular charges and nondegenerate folds. Ten independent defining-integral tests for \(n=1,\ldots,5\) have residual below \(10^{-45}\); symbolic differential identities were checked for \(n=1,\ldots,12\). Finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: PASS: This is a complete all-order classification of natural STFT nodal geometry under a positive Hermite window-amplitude deformation. It reveals \(n-1\) exact radial critical amplitudes, a sharp global range from \(2n\) to \(2n^2\) isolated nodes, and index conservation through \(n\) simultaneous nonregular folds per radial gap. Beyond evaluating a known Hermite STFT polynomial, it determines the complete natural one-parameter zero-count invariant at every Hermite order, including equality cases, and gives a computable threshold prescription.
